name: RetroRunner 1
author: Darsh_Khandelwal
description:
Hey guys, Darsh here! Here's my microgame from scratch. I used Expat Studio tutorials and sprites on YouTube to create this homage to Retro Mario. There are 12 Levels!!                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                           
Use the left/right arrow keys to move.                                                            Use the up arrow key, space bar, or left mouse button to jump.                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                 I hope you guys enjoy! Let me know what you think of it!!
